'''Sasha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] until she broke all ties with the Rebellion and made a living from her [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] skills on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

==History==
[[File:Sasha_lunch_break.png|thumb|left|200px|Sasha as an explorer.]]
Sasha's parents were early [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members who raised her lovingly and constantly moved between uninhabited planets on the run from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which from a young age sparked Sasha's interest in exploring.<ref name="Folio">{{FantasyFlightGames|subdomain=images-cdn|url=ffg_content/StarWarsRPG/edge-of-the-empire/beginner-game/Support/Bonus%20Adventure/High%20Rez/Character_Folio_Sasha_HR.pdf|text=Sasha the Explorer Character Folio}}</ref>

As she grew up, Sasha also joined the Rebels, inspired by a desire to bring back harmony and democracy to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Her idealism, however, was broken after an eventful [[Mission to Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|mission on Onderon]], in which, after accidentally giving away her position to Imperials, she was left without support from the Rebels and survived only to remain stranded on Onderon for some time.<ref name="Folio" />

After the abandonment by the Rebels, Sasha saw her loyalty to the Rebel Alliance shattered. She then resorted to selling her skills as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] to make a living, and, although she made good profit from it, she always wished to leave the planet where so many of her mates perished.<ref name="Folio" />

[[File:Sasha_the_Scout.png|thumb|right|200px|Sasha put her skills as a scout to her advantage.]]
When [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Oskara]] hired Sasha to track down an individual through wild country, she took her to [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as a reward for the successfully completed mission.<ref name="Folio" />

On Tatooine, Sasha kept working as a freelance explorer and began friendships with Oskara and technician [[Mathus]], [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] leading mechanic. Tagging along with them, she took part in a rescue mission to save one of Teemo's servants.<ref name="Folio" />
